brief_summary: GLP-1 receptor agonists delay gastric emptying and are associated with a higher rate of retained gastric content (RGC) during upper gastrointestinal endoscopy, even under standard fasting. No randomized trial has compared fasting strategies in this population. CLEAR-GLP1 is a multicentre, international, investigator-blinded randomized trial comparing a 24-hour clear liquid diet (followed by a 2-hour fast) with standard fasting (6 hours for solids, 2 hours for clear liquids) in adults on GLP-1 RA therapy undergoing elective upper endoscopy. GLP-1 RA therapy is not interrupted in either arm. The primary outcome is the rate of clinically significant RGC, defined as a GRACE stomach score of 0.
brief_title: 24-hour Clear Liquid Diet vs. Standard Fasting for Upper Gastrointestinal Endoscopy in Patients Taking Agonists of the GLP-1 Receptor
official_title: 24-hour Clear Liquid Diet vs. Standard Fasting for Upper Gastrointestinal Endoscopy in Patients Taking Agonists of the GLP-1 Receptor (CLEAR-GLP1 Trial): a Randomized, Parallel-group, Multicentre, International Clinical Trial

primary_outcomes.time_frame: During the index upper gastrointestinal endoscopy (Day 0)
